spans.s: देव् vt. 1Ā (pres. देवते) 1. To sport, to play, to gamble (according to some authorities); 2. to lament (according to others).With परि-, to lament.
देव (I) a. (f. वी) Divine, celestial, Bg.xi.11.

देव (II) m. 1. A deity, a god, M.iii.117, xii.117; 2. a Brāhmaṇa; 3. an appellation affixed to the name of a Brāhmaṇa, (e.g. गोविंददेव); 4. a king; 5. a tittle of honour used in addressing a king (‘your majesty’) देवाकर्णय येन येन सहसा यद् यत् समासादितम् K.Pr.x.; 6. Indra, the god of rain, as in देवो ववर्ष.
देव (I) a. (f. वी) Divine, celestial, Bg.xi.11.

देवी f. 1. A female deity, a goddess; 2. an epithet of Durgā; 3. of Sarasvatī; 4. of Sāvitrī; 5. a queen, especially the chief queen who has been consecrated with her husband (in theatrical language particularly), देवीभावं गमिता परिवारपदं कथं भजत्येषा K.Pr.x.; 6. a respectful epithet applied to a lady of rank.
देव-अंश m. a partial incarnation of god.
देव-अगार m.n. a temple.
देव-अंगना f. a divine female, an apsaras.
देव-अतिदेव, -अधिदेव m. 1. the greatest god; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
देव-अतिदेव, -अधिदेव m. 1. the greatest god; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
देव-अधिप m. an epithet of Indra.
देव-अंधस, -अन्न n. 1. divine food, ambrosia; 2. food that has been first presented to an idol. See M.v.7, and Kull. on it.
देव-अंधस, -अन्न n. 1. divine food, ambrosia; 2. food that has been first presented to an idol. See M.v.7, and Kull. on it.
देवन (I) m. A doe.
देवन (II) n. 1. Splendour, lustre, beauty; 2. gambling, a game at dice; 3. a sport, pastime; 4. a pleasure ground, a garden; 5. a lotus; 6. emulation, desire to excel; 7. affair, business.
देवना f. Gambling, a game at dice.
देव-अभीष्ट a. sacred or dedicated to a deity.
देव-अभीष्टा f. piper betel.
देव-अरण्य n. the garden of gods, the Nandana garden, R.x.80.
देव-अरि m. a demon.
देव-अर्चन n. worship of the gods.
देव-अर्चना f. worship of the gods.
देव-अवसथ m. a temple.
देव-अश्व m. an epithet of उच्चैःश्रवस्, the horse of Indra.
देव-स्व n. 1. property of gods, property applicable to religious purposes or endowments; 2. the property of sacrifices. See M.xi.20.
देव-आक्रीड m. Nandana, the garden of the gods.
देव-आजीव, -आजीविन् n. an attendant upon an idol, a low Brāhmaṇa subsisting upon the offerings made to an idol.
देव-आजीव, -आजीविन् n. an attendant upon an idol, a low Brāhmaṇa subsisting upon the offerings made to an idol.
देव-आत्मन् m. the holy fig tree.
देव-आयतन n. a temple, M.iv.46.
देव-आयुध n. 1. a divine weapon; 2. rainbow.
देव-आलय m. 1. heaven; 2. a temple.
देव-आवास m. 1. heaven; 2. the holy fig tree; 3. a temple; 4. the Sumeru mountain.
देव-आहार m. nectar, ambrosia.
देव-इज् a. (nom. sing. देवेट्-ड्) worshipping gods.
देव-इज्य m. an epithet of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of gods.
देव-इंद्र, -ईश m. 1. an epithet of Indra; 2. of Śiva.
देव-इंद्र, -ईश m. 1. an epithet of Indra; 2. of Śiva.
देव-उद्यान n. 1. a divine garden; 2. garden near a temple.
देवऋषि m. 1. a divine sage; 2. an epithet of Nārada, एवं वादिनि देवर्षौ K.S.vi.84.
देवऋषि m. 1. a divine sage; 2. an epithet of Nārada, एवं वादिनि देवर्षौ K.S.vi.84.
देव-ओकस् n. the mountain Sumeru.
देव-कन्या f. a nymph.
देव-कर्मन्, -कार्य n. 1. a religious act or rite; 2. worship of the gods.
देव-कर्मन्, -कार्य n. 1. a religious act or rite; 2. worship of the gods.
देव-काष्ठ n. the Devadāru tree.
देव-कुंड n. a natural spring.
देव-कुल n. 1. a temple; 2. a race of god; 3. a multitude of gods.
देव-कुल्या f. the celestial Ganges.
देव-कुसुम n. cloves.
देव-खात, -खातक n. 1. a natural hollow among mountains; 2. a natural pond or reservoir, M.iv.203; 3. a pond near a temple.
देव-खात, -खातक n. 1. a natural hollow among mountains; 2. a natural pond or reservoir, M.iv.203; 3. a pond near a temple.
देव-खात˚बिल n. a cavern, a chasm.
देव-गण m. a class of gods.
देव-गणिका f. an apsaras.
देव-गर्जन n. thunder.
देव-गायन m. a celestial chorister, a Gandharva.
देव-गिरि m. name of a mountain, Megh.i.42.
देव-गुरु m. 1. an epithet of Kaśyapa (as the father of gods); 2. an epithet of Bṛhaspati (as the preceptor of gods).
देव-गुही f. an epithet of Sarasvatī.
देव-गृह n. 1. a temple; 2. the palace of a king.
देव-चर्या f. worship or service of the gods.
देव-चिकित्सक m. du. Aśvins, the twin physicians of the gods.
देव-च्छंद m. a pearl-necklace of hundred strings.
देव-तरु m. 1. the holy fig tree; 2. a tree of paradise; (they are मंदार, पारिजात, संतान, कल्प and हरिचंदन), Bh.V.i.22.
देव-ताड m. 1. fire; 2. an epithet of Rāhu.
देव-दत्त m. name of the conch shell of Arjuna, Bg.i.15.
देव-दारु n. a species of pine, K.S.i.54, R.ii.36.
देव-दासी f. 1. a female devoted to the service of a temple; 2. a courtezan employed as a dancer in a temple.
देव-दीप m. the eye.
देव-दूत m. a divine envoy, an angel.
देव-दुंदुभि m. 1. a divine drum; 2. holy basil with red flowers.
देव-देव m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. of Śiva, K.S.i.52; 3. of Viṣṇu.
देव-द्रोणी f. a procession with idols.
देवद्र्यंच् a. (f. द्रीची) adoring a deity.
देवद्र्यंच् a. (f. द्रीची) adoring a deity.
देव-धर्म m. a religious duty or office.
देव-नदी f. 1. the Ganges; 2. a holy river, M.ii.17.
देव-नंदिन् m. name of the door-keeper of Indra.
देव-नागरी f. name of the character in which Sanskrit is usually written.
देव-निकाय m. paradise, heaven.
देव-निंदक m. an unbeliever, a heretic, an atheist.
देव-निर्मित a. god-created, i.e. natural.
देव-पति m. an epithet of Indra.
देव-पथ m. 1. heaven, firmament; 2. the milky way.
देव-पशु m. any animal consecrated to a diety.
देव-पुर्, -पुरी f. an epithet of Amarāvatī, the city of Indra.
देव-पुर्, -पुरी f. an epithet of Amarāvatī, the city of Indra.
देव-पूज्य m. an epithet of Bṛhaspati.
देव-प्रतिकृति, -प्रतिमा f. the image of a deity, an idol.
देव-प्रतिकृति, -प्रतिमा f. the image of a deity, an idol.
देव-प्रश्न m. fortune-telling, consulting the deities, astrology.
देवानांप्रिय m. 1. a goat; 2. a fool, an idiot, तेप्यतात्पर्यज्ञास्तात्पर्यवाचोयुक्तेर्देवानांप्रियाः K.Pr.v.
देव-बलि m. an oblation to the god.
देव-ब्रह्मन् m. an epithet of Nārada.
देव-ब्राह्मण m. a Brāhmaṇa who lives on the income of an idol.
देव-भवन n. 1. heaven; 2. a temple; 3. the holy fig tree.
देव-भूमि f. heaven.
देव-भूति f. an epithet of the Ganges.
देव-भूय n. divinity, godhead.
देव-भृत् m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Indra.
देव-मणि m. 1. the jewel of Viṣṇu called कौस्तुभ; 2. the sun.

देव-मातृक a. watered by the clouds only, deprived of every other kind of water, depending for its crops on rain and not on irrigation (as a country), (op. to नदीमातृक), अदेवमातृकाः (i.e. नदीमात्रुकाः) चिराय तस्मिन्कुरवश्चकासते Kir.i.17.
देव-मानक m. the jewel of Viṣṇu called कौस्तुभ.
देव-मुनि m. a divine sage.
देव-यजन n. a sacrificial yard, the place where a sacrifice is performed.
देव-यजि a. making oblations to gods.
देव-यज्ञ m. a sacrifice to the superior gods by oblations to fire, (one of the five daily sacrifices of a Brāhmaṇa. See M.iii.84, 85).
देव-यात्रा f. an idol-procession, any sacred festival when the idols are carried in procession.
देव-यान n. a celestial car.
देव-रथ m. a celestial car.
देव-युग n. the first of the four ages of the world (in Hindu mythology) otherwise called कृतयुग.
देव-योनि m. a superhuman being, a demi-god.
देव-योषा f. an apsaras.
देव-रहस्य n. a divine mystery.
देव-राज्, -राज m. an epithet of Indra.
देव-राज्, -राज m. an epithet of Indra.
देव-लता f. the navamallikā plant.
देव-लिंग n. the image or statue of a deity.
देव-लोक m. heaven, paradise, M.iv.182.
देव-वक्त्र n. an epithet of fire.
देव-वर्त्मन् n. the sky.
देव-वर्धकि, -शिल्पिन् m. Viśvakarman, the architect of gods.
देव-वर्धकि, -शिल्पिन् m. Viśvakarman, the architect of gods.
देव-वाणी f. a divine voice, a voice from heaven.
देव-वाहन m. an epithet of Agni.
देव-व्रत (I) n. religious observance.
देव-व्रत (II) m. 1. an epithet of Bhīṣma; 2. of Kārtikeya.
देव-शत्रु m. a demon.
देव-शुनी f. an epithet of Saramā, the divine female dog.
देव-शेष n. the remnants of a sacrifice offered to the gods.
देव-श्रुत m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Nārada; 3. a sacred treatise.
देव-सभा ??? 1. Sudharmā, the assembly of gods; 2. a gambling house.
देव-सात् ind. to the disposition of a god or gods.
देव-सायुज्य n. conjunction with the god, deification.
देव-सेना f. 1. the army of gods; 2. name of the wife of Kārtikeya (?), See R.vii.1 and Mall. ad. loc.
देव-सेना˚पति m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
देव-हविस् n. an animal (offered to gods at a sacrifice.)
देवकी f. Name of a daughter of Devaka, wife of Vasudeva and mother of Kṛṣṇa.
देवकी-नंदन, -पुत्र, -मातृ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
देवकी-नंदन, -पुत्र, -मातृ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
देवकी-नंदन, -पुत्र, -मातृ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
देवट m. An artizan.
देवता f. 1. Divine dignity, divinity; 2. a deity, a god, K.S.i.1; 3. the image of a deity; 4. an organ of sense.
देवता-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -गृह न्। m.n. a temple.
देवता-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -गृह न्। m.n. a temple.
देवता-गृह n. a temple.
देवता-अधिप m. an epithet of Indra.
देवता-अभ्यर्चन n. worshipping a deity.
देवता-आयतन न्।, -आलय म्।, -वेश्मन् न्। n. a temple, a chapel.
देवता-आलय m. a temple, a chapel.
देवता-आयतन न्।, -आलय म्।, -वेश्मन् न्। n. a temple, a chapel.
देवता-प्रतिमा f. the image of a god, an idol.
देवता-स्नान n. the ablution of an idol.
देवन् m. The younger brother of a husband.
देवर m. 1. A husband’s brother in general, M.iii.55; 2. a husband’s younger brother, Yaj.i.68.
देवर m. 1. A husband’s brother in general, M.iii.55; 2. a husband’s younger brother, Yaj.i.68.
देवल m. An attendant upon an idol, a low Brāhmaṇa who subsists upon the offerings made to an idol.
देविक a. (f. की) Divine, derived from a divinity.
देविक a. (f. की) Divine, derived from a divinity.
देविल a. (f. ला) Divine, derived from a divinity.
देविल a. (f. ला) Divine, derived from a divinity.
